scope: One retrospective full-threshold comparison of the two existing score operators on consumed arrays. No new model, operator, field, scene, risk definition or certificate.
primary: Fixed uniform-selected action, with the original independent tie variable and absolute tie tolerance 1e-9. Compare both scores on exactly that action and truth.
secondary: Each operator selects its own action once, before thresholding. Rejection never triggers a new choice.
tracks: Perfect target64-to16 (one track) and all five existing learned fields. Learned primary curve uses one shared threshold across all five models; also retain all five individual-model curves.
threshold_family: Every distinct score, accepting score<=threshold; equal scores enter together. Include reject-all with undefined conditional risk. No interpolation or randomized partial ties. Any global shift of the uniform score is covered by this entire threshold family.
risk: Unsafe accepted / all accepted; truth remains c_ref>.02. Conditional risk can be nonmonotonic along a threshold curve: scan every eligible threshold, not only until the first crossing.
efficiency: Safe accepted / scenes with at least one reference-safe candidate. Availability is fixed across operators, and is repeated across five models without treating model-scene entries as independent.
frontier: For each empirical risk ceiling, maximize safe-accepted count among all thresholds meeting it; ties prefer fewer unsafe accepts then the smaller threshold. Optimize both operators identically on the same consumed bank. This is an outcome-selected empirical envelope, not an out-of-sample operating rule or a risk guarantee.
raw_curves: Preserve every empirical threshold point for both banks, both selectors, pooled tracks and each individual learned model, including harms and unfavorable ranges. Plot both complete raw paths and empirical envelopes.
uncertainty: 1000 paired bootstrap draws, seed 2612091501. Target resamples scenes; pooled learned resamples five model indices and shared scene indices. Recompute each envelope in each draw. Pointwise descriptive percentile intervals; they do not correct outcome-selection optimism or provide simultaneous guarantees.
development_transfer: Select thresholds on development at every listed risk ceiling using the same maximization for each operator; apply those exact thresholds on the consumed appended bank and report actual risk and efficiency, without calling that bank independent or certified.

continuation_gate.purpose: A newly fixed operational stopping rule before reading these full curves, not a preregistered scientific hypothesis; both banks were already consumed.
continuation_gate.required: In the primary fixed-action learned track, at least three consecutive listed risk ceilings between .005 and .03 (span at least .01) must, on BOTH banks, have PLIC-minus-uniform efficiency>=.005 (0.5 percentage point), pointwise paired bootstrap lower>0, and positive individual-model envelope differences for at least four of five models. Five seeds limit interpretation even if this gate passes.
continuation_gate.failure: Stop experimental expansion and revise as a controlled diagnostic case study. Oracle-only separation, isolated risk points, or uncertainty do not trigger fresh data.
continuation_gate.success: At most one development-fixed operating point may be evaluated independently after a separate frozen protocol. Pick the middle point of the longest qualifying run, lower point on ties. No model or operator search; one unsupported or uncertain independent result also stops. This gate does not establish ICLR-level novelty.

cancellation: Keep 25/43 as a retrospective outcome-conditioned event pattern. Both error terms change; do not claim causal shares, independent module interventions, or a deployable predictor. No subgroup search is authorized.
budget: One CPU analysis allocation <=30 minutes, 4 cores; independent arithmetic verification and plotting <=20 minutes. Document builds separate. No third bank unless the fixed continuation gate passes.
